/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'substOld|getVars' Strata/Languages/Core/OldExpressions.lean Strata/DL/Lambda/LExpr.lean Strata/Languages/Core/Expression.lean; sed -n '2810,2880p' Strata/Transform/CallElimCorrect.lean; sed -n '3088,3200p' Strata/Transform/CallElimCorrect.lean; rg --files | rg 'OldExpr|Expression.lean|LExpr.lean'"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '156,205p' Strata/Languages/Core/OldExpressions.lean; sed -n '295,318p' Strata/DL/Lambda/LExpr.lean; rg -n 'getVars.*:=|getVars :=' Strata/Languages/Core; ls -a .lake; ls -a .lake/packages | head -30; which lean"

/bin/bash -lc 'PREFIX=$(lean --print-prefix); rg -n '"'theorem (subset_append|mem_append|append_subset)|def Subset|theorem Subset' \""'$PREFIX/src/lean/Init/Data/List/Basic.lean" "$PREFIX/src/lean/Init/Data/List/Lemmas.lean" | head -100; sed -n '"'12,38p' Strata/Languages/Core/Expressions.lean"

/bin/bash -lc "cat > candidate.lean <<'EOF'
open OldExpressions in
theorem substOldPostSubset:
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression)
    (substOld h2 (Lambda.LExpr.fvar m h1 ty) post)).Subset
    (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression) post ++ [h1]) := by
  have join {a b c d : List Expression.Ident}
      (ha : a ⊆ c ++ [h1]) (hb : b ⊆ d ++ [h1]) :
      a ++ b ⊆ (c ++ d) ++ [h1] := by
    intro x hx
    simp only [List.mem_append] at hx ⊢
    exact hx.elim
      (fun hx => (List.mem_append.mp (ha hx)).imp Or.inl id)
      (fun hx => (List.mem_append.mp (hb hx)).imp Or.inr id)
  induction post <;> simp only [substOld]
  case const | bvar | fvar | op =>
    exact fun _ hx => List.mem_append_left _ hx
  case abs ih => exact ih
  case quant ih1 ih2 => exact join ih1 ih2
  case eq ih1 ih2 => exact join ih1 ih2
  case ite ih1 ih2 ih3 => exact join ih1 (join ih2 ih3)
  case app ih1 ih2 =>
    split
    · split
      · exact fun _ hx => List.mem_append_right _ hx
      · exact fun _ hx => List.mem_append_left _ hx
    · exact join ih1 ih2
EOF
python check_candidate.py candidate.lean"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -i 's/exact join ih1 (join ih2 ih3)/exact join (join ih1 ih2) ih3/' candidate.lean
python check_candidate.py candidate.lean"
